title: GAB-Outreach-Generator Input
description: Publisher profile used to generate a targeted cold outreach email for a Google Authorized Buyer programmatic monetization program.

domain.description: Publisher domain name (e.g. 'breakingnews.com'). Used for subject line personalization and contextual framing.

vertical.description: Publisher content vertical. Determines which technical hooks are selected. Known values: news, finance, lifestyle, utilities, gaming, tech, health, travel. Unknown values fall back to default hooks.

traffic_tier.description: Publisher traffic tier classification. Determines emphasis of the value proposition.

contact_name.description: First name of the recipient. Optional. When present, used in the salutation as 'Hi [contact_name],'. When absent or empty, salutation defaults to 'Hi,'.
